content.title: Results Repeat Named One of America's Fastest Growing Private Companies - Results Repeat
content.text: Inc. Magazine revealed that Results Repeat is No. 3,072 with a growth rate of 123% percent on its annual Inc. 5000 list, the most prestigious ranking of the nation’s fastest-growing private companies. The list represents a unique look at the most successful companies within the American economy’s most dynamic segment—its independent small businesses. “We are thrilled to have made the Inc. 5000 list two years in a row and are especially grateful that we managed to grow during what was a very challenging year.” says Results Repeat Founder and CEO Ellen Thompson, “This was made possible by our incredible team members who always do an amazing job. Thanks especially to those who went above and beyond to support their co-workers who are parents and had to provide care and homeschooling for young children.” Not only have the companies on the 2021 Inc. 5000 been very competitive within their markets, but the list as a whole shows staggering growth compared with prior lists as well. The 2021 Inc. 5000 achieved an incredible three-year average growth of over 500 percent and a median rate of 165 percent. Complete results of the Inc. 5000, including company profiles and an interactive database that can be sorted by industry, region, and other criteria, can be found at www.inc.com/inc5000. CONTACT: For more information contact Katie Hagan, Strategic Partnership Manager via email at katieh@resultsrepeat.com. About Results Repeat Results Repeat is a certified Women’s Business Enterprise and Woman Owned Small Business. Founded in 2014, the company is an award-winning digital marketing agency providing SEO, PPC, CRO, website development, and social advertising. Steered by a team of skillful, creative, intelligent, and results-driven digital marketers, we work with 300+ business owners and marketing directors to generate more business from their online digital presence. Results Repeat has appeared on The Philadelphia 100 for three consecutive years, Best Place to Work by The Philadelphia Business Journal, NAA Best Place to Work, recognized by Inc 5000 as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies, and appeared on the Financial Times as Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies. About Inc. Media The world’s most trusted business-media brand, Inc. offers entrepreneurs the knowledge, tools, connections, and community to build great companies. Its award-winning multiplatform content reaches more than 50 million people each month across a variety of channels including websites, newsletters, social media, podcasts, and print. Its prestigious Inc. 5000 list, produced every year since 1982, analyzes company data to recognize the fastest-growing privately held businesses in the United States. The global recognition that comes with inclusion in the 5000 gives the founders of the best businesses an opportunity to engage with an exclusive community of their peers and the credibility that helps them drive sales and recruit talent. The associated Inc. 5000 Conference is part of a highly acclaimed portfolio of bespoke events produced by Inc. For more information, visit www.inc.com. For more information on the Inc. 5000 Conference, visit http://conference.inc.com/.
